title: Civic Notice: The Mall Fountain
description: A Snazzie FM Civic Notification System test. The fountain at the center of Snazzie Mall has begun returning the coins, and it is keeping a list.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Do not retrieve coins from the fountain at the center of Snazzie Mall. <p:0.5> It is no longer accepting wishes. It has begun returning them.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: If the water is moving and there is no wind, do not look at it. <p:0.3> Continue at a normal pace toward the nearest exit.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: If you hear your name from beneath the surface, do not answer. <p:0.3> You have not been called.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This concludes the test of the Civic Notification System.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> The fountain has been counting since the mall opened. <p:0.5> It has counted you many times. Please remain calm. You have always been calm.
